newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai bourse resumes trading in Sri Dhana.
newsitem.headline: Thai bourse resumes trading in Sri Dhana.

text.p: The Thai bourse said on Thursday it would allow trading in the suspended shares of Sri Dhana Finance Plc from this afternoon after the firm clarified its capital increase plans in line with a Bank of Thailand order.
The Stock Exchange of Thailand said Sri Dhana Finance on March 3 had requested the stock exchange suspend trade in its shares after the central bank ordered it to raise capital.
Sri Dhana earlier said in a filing that it plans to increase registered capital to 855 million baht ($32.88 million) from 621.25 million.
BOT on Monday ordered 10 finance companies including Sri Dhana Finance to raise capital immediately in a move to restore confidence in local finance firms.
